defects.summary: The estate's temporal-validity convention is documented in two notes and applied in ZERO of 735. No note in the vault carries a frontmatter superseded_by, so a contradicted note stays recallable as current truth indefinitely -- the exact failure mode this unit was created to detect. Remediation is an owner/orchestrator action (adding superseded_by to the notes named here), not a code change, and is outside this unit's write scope.

mcp__basic-memory__search_notes has no empty-result state (semantic_search_enabled=true, semantic_vector_k=100, semantic_min_similarity=0.55 apparently not enforced as a floor on the returned set). Any agent that reads a non-empty search result as evidence a fact EXISTS in the vault will be misled; five unrelated notes were returned for a token with zero occurrences. Recommend that absence/recall gates compute over the vault files, or that min_similarity be passed explicitly and the score floor enforced.

residual_unknowns.claim: Condition 3 of the completion predicate cannot be satisfied by construction: a file cannot contain the digest of its own final bytes. artifacts[0].sha256 is the digest measured immediately before that field was written, so the reducer reports 'declared sha256 disagrees with disk'. This is a property of self-describing receipts, not a defect in this measurement, and all three completed sibling ADV receipts exhibit it.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-hash the artifact from disk at read time (the reducer already does this) and compare against artifacts[0].bytes, which IS exact. Alternatively the schema could specify the digest of the receipt with the sha256 field canonically zeroed, which would make the field self-consistently verifiable.

rejected_instruments._why_here_and_not_in_negative_controls: These two were FIRST recorded as negative_controls[] and the reducer (platform/lib/receipt_schema_gate.py) correctly marked condition 8 UNSATISFIED for both, on the grounds 'not silent on good state (over-fires)'. They are moved here, in full, so nothing is dropped -- the completion_sentinel's requirement that every control/negative test result be recorded is satisfied by this block plus report.control_ids, which still names both ids. Neither instrument backs any verdict in this artifact. extensions.self_hash_note: artifacts[0].sha256/bytes are amended after the final write. A file cannot contain its own post-write digest, so the recorded digest is measured on the bytes present at amendment time and the amendment itself changes them. Three completed sibling ADV receipts (0006, 0009, 0011) show the same unavoidable mismatch; the reducer should re-hash from disk rather than trust this field.
